title: dispatch's worker leaves a work row in the spool land reads, or dispatch names where its rows went
goal: A worker that backlog.py dispatch starts leaves a branch, agent-start or agent-stop row naming its item in the spool land and cost read, or dispatch's closing line names the spool its session's rows went to

gates.question: How does dispatch's closing line find where the worker's session rows went: search only the spools land and cost read, or also the other plugin data spools of the host?
options: search the spools land and cost read, plus CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA and ~/.claude/plugins/data/*/querylog/spool
search only the spools land and cost read
gates.recommendation: search the spools land and cost read, plus CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA and ~/.claude/plugins/data/*/querylog/spool
gates.answer: search the spools land and cost read, plus CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA and ~/.claude/plugins/data/*/querylog/spool
